006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import java.net.URI;
009import java.util.List;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItem;
012import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
013
014/**
015 * A {@link ValidationEventListener} that delegates all events to multiple
016 * listeners.
017 * <p>
018 * This enables multiple independent consumers (e.g., {@link TimingCollector}
019 * for aggregate timing and a SARIF handler for per-result timing) to receive
020 * the same validation events.
021 *
022 * @see ValidationEventListener
023 */
024public class CompositeValidationEventListener implements ValidationEventListener {
025  @NonNull
026  private final List<ValidationEventListener> listeners;
027
028  /**
029   * Construct a composite listener that delegates to the given listeners.
030   *
031   * @param listeners
032   *          the listeners to delegate to, in order
033   */
034  public CompositeValidationEventListener(@NonNull List<ValidationEventListener> listeners) {
035    this.listeners = List.copyOf(listeners);
036  }
037
038  @Override
039  public void beforeValidation(@NonNull URI document) {
040    for (ValidationEventListener listener : listeners) {
041      listener.beforeValidation(document);
042    }
043  }
044
045  @Override
046  public void afterValidation(@NonNull URI document) {
047    for (ValidationEventListener listener : listeners) {
048      listener.afterValidation(document);
049    }
050  }
051
052  @Override
053  public void beforePhase(@NonNull ValidationPhase phase) {
054    for (ValidationEventListener listener : listeners) {
055      listener.beforePhase(phase);
056    }
057  }
058
059  @Override
060  public void afterPhase(@NonNull ValidationPhase phase) {
061    for (ValidationEventListener listener : listeners) {
062      listener.afterPhase(phase);
063    }
064  }
065
066  @Override
067  public void beforeConstraintEvaluation(@NonNull IConstraint constraint, @NonNull INodeItem target) {
068    for (ValidationEventListener listener : listeners) {
069      listener.beforeConstraintEvaluation(constraint, target);
070    }
071  }
072
073  @Override
074  public void afterConstraintEvaluation(@NonNull IConstraint constraint, @NonNull INodeItem target) {
075    for (ValidationEventListener listener : listeners) {
076      listener.afterConstraintEvaluation(constraint, target);
077    }
078  }
079
080  @Override
081  public void beforeLetEvaluation(@NonNull ILet let) {
082    for (ValidationEventListener listener : listeners) {
083      listener.beforeLetEvaluation(let);
084    }
085  }
086
087  @Override
088  public void afterLetEvaluation(@NonNull ILet let) {
089    for (ValidationEventListener listener : listeners) {
090      listener.afterLetEvaluation(let);
091    }
092  }
093}
